summary: Home Manager activation writes and verifies .fractal-install.json ownership receipts using the incoming Fractal package, independently of compatibility aliases.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection changes.

schema.detail: No database schema changes; activation uses the schema-1 installer ownership file.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rules change.

compatibility.detail: A valid receipt recognizes an existing executable without aliases. Invalid or symlinked receipts stop activation with their path and reinstall guidance. Existing aliases remain recognized and unchanged.

manual.detail: Keep .fractal-install.json beside the matching executable; restore both together when recovering an installation.

recovery.detail: Activation rollback restores both the prior executable and receipt if publication or alias updates fail.
